title: temporary directory owner v1
description: `owner.json` in a directory some process made outside every checkout, beside the `owner.lock` that process holds for as long as it uses the directory. Every program of this repository that makes such a directory writes this document, and a collector on the machine reads it: a lock nobody holds means the owner is gone, `kept` means it was preserved on purpose, and a cache is spared while the tree it is keyed to exists. A directory without it names no owner and is nobody's to remove.

schema.description: Which program wrote the marker, ending in the shape's own name.

pid.description: The process that claimed the directory; diagnostic only, since liveness is the lock's.

started.description: When the directory was claimed, in UTC.

kept.description: Whether the directory was preserved on purpose; only an explicit release ends a keep.

role.description: What the directory is for; absent means a scratch.

keyed_to.description: The tree a cache is keyed to, absolutely: once it is gone, nothing can look the cache up again.
